findings.label: Unreachable last-user destroy guard
findings.detail: UserController@destroy's `User::count() === 1` branch can never be true for a non-self target, since a lone user is always the authenticated user and the self-deletion guard returns first. The test_cannot_delete_the_last_remaining_user test only deletes self (its own comment notes the self-guard fires first), so the branch is uncovered and unreachable. Harmless belt-and-suspenders code; no change required to ship.
